title: Poor quality placemats.
text:
Poor quality placemats.. Placemats arrived bent and damaged. The color is pretty, but the placemats are very thin and are of poor quality.

I do not recommend.

product_metadata.title: London Woven Spiral Table Placemats 16.9 X 13 Inches Oval Set of 4 Non-Slip Dining Red
features: SET OF FOUR: Measuring 16.9 X 13 Inches Oval, these placemats are the perfect fit for most round, square, and oblong tables.
DURABLE PROTECTION: Protect your surfaces with these durable non-slip heat resistant woven placemats. Constructed from 75% Polypropylene & 25% Polyester.

PERFECT DÉCOR: add style to your table setting, offered in 9 rich color options, these woven place mats will add a pop of color to your table setting. Coordinate with your home and table décor for special occasions, holidays, and everyday use.

REVERSIBLE: Woven with a reversible weave, these placemats can be used on either side and are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. Spice up any patio or dining room table with these unique placemats.
EASY CLEAN: Simply wipe the placemats down with a damp cloth, or rinse in the sink with warm water.
description: Dress up your table in style With These Beautiful Oval Place-mats.
This placemat is perfect for everyday indoor and outdoor dining experiences. It is thick, soft, long-lasting, and reversible for extended use.
Heat resistant woven tablemats with beautiful design not only can protect your dinner table, but also is a stylish decoration for your home.
This placemat is excellent for protecting your table from stains and scratches and extending the life of your table.
Brighten up the holiday accent for your dinner table. Special designed for the Christmas and holiday use or everyday use.
